panels.scene: A giant clock tower with a large bell inside is stopped. Cobwebs fill the clock face. Knight stands below, holding a wrench, looking bored. Villagers are panicking, holding their heads.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The ads... they're GONE! Is this the end of capitalism?

panels.title: Disable meta-ads-report cron
panels.scene: A tiny gremlin labeled 'meta-ads-report cron' is being evicted from a cozy little house. The knight is holding an eviction notice. The gremlin is crying.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The reporting... it rests. He has spared us from the numbers!

panels.title: Disable meta-ads-report cron
panels.scene: Villagers are throwing a funeral procession for a spreadsheet. They are carrying it in a coffin draped with a black cloth. The knight watches, arms crossed.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall never forget the pivot tables! The VLOOKUP!

panels.scene: Knight sitting on a small stool looking utterly bored. In the background, villagers are erecting a small shrine dedicated to the 'pause' button. One villager is carving a tiny pause symbol.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall call this day... 'The Great Cron Pause'!
